record_body:
Account summary
- Compliance-sensitive prospect (financial services). Primary concern is telemetry/analytics during onboarding and whether any prompt or customer content is captured.
- Evaluating Redwood Hosted API for an internal knowledge assistant + ticket summarization, but expects to move regulated workloads to VPC/private if approved.

Firmographics
- Name: Northstar Finance
- Domain: northstarfinance.com
- Size: 1000+
- Region: NA (HQ US; strict preference for US-only processing in initial phase)

Deal / stage notes (current: Evaluation)
- They are willing to run a time-boxed POC if security/privacy items are answered in writing.
- They asked specifically about the new guided onboarding checklist telemetry (Console events) and whether any payload could include customer data.
- Strong preference: telemetry is allowed only if it’s metadata-only, property allowlisted, and retained for a short, documented window with strict access controls.

Use case + workload
- Primary workloads:
  - Internal doc search / retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over policies & procedures (non-public corp docs)
  - Summarization of support/case notes (may include PII depending on business unit)
- Modes:
  - Chat completions + streaming for interactive UX
  - Embeddings for retrieval
- Performance expectations (rough): low-latency interactive responses for internal users; throughput spikes during business hours; wants predictable tail latency more than peak TPS.

Product interest
- Hosted API (Phase 1, non-PII pilot path)
- Private (VPC) required for anything containing customer PII / regulated data
- Optimize: interested in cost controls (batching/caching guidance) once baseline quality is validated

Security / compliance requirements (highlights)
- Hard requirements discussed:
  - No customer prompt content collected in onboarding telemetry (explicit)
  - Audit logging and exportability (who accessed what in Console; admin actions)
  - KMS integration expectations (customer-managed keys preferred for private deployment)
  - Retention controls and documented retention periods for logs/telemetry
  - Data residency: US-only (initial), no cross-region failover without approval
  - SSO/SAML for Console access if they proceed beyond POC
- Questions asked verbatim/near-verbatim:
  - “Does onboarding telemetry include any request/response content?”
  - “Can you prove that only allowlisted properties are emitted?”
  - “Where is this telemetry stored and who can access it internally?”
  - “What is the retention period and can we request deletion?”

Telemetry/privacy thread (why this account matters to project)
- Their security team flagged that product-led onboarding often introduces analytics that are not compatible with financial services policies.
- Requested a written statement of:
  - event schema + property allowlist approach
  - redaction rules
  - retention tags / TTL
  - access controls (which internal teams can query)
- This directly fed into internal work on onboarding telemetry privacy review and property allowlisting.

Recent activity timeline
- 2026-02-19: Security/telemetry review call (Fireflies: ff-2026-02-19-security-telemetry-review-northstar). Outcome: generally positive if we can document “no prompt content” + retention/access controls; they requested follow-up packet.
- 2026-02-12: Email exchange: asked for data residency + retention FAQ and whether Console analytics can be disabled per org during POC.
- 2026-02-05: POC scoping call: discussed limiting pilot to non-PII corp docs and synthetic prompts.
- 2026-01-22: Intro/demo: focus on reliability, fallbacks, and production readiness checklist; they asked how “first production launch” is defined.

Key contacts (as noted)
- VP Security Engineering (buyer/influencer)
- Enterprise Architecture lead (technical gate)
- Product owner for internal assistant (end user sponsor)

Open items / next steps
- Send: Redwood telemetry/privacy one-pager + data residency/retention FAQ + confirmation that onboarding telemetry is metadata-only (no prompt content) with allowlist enforcement.
- Confirm: whether Hosted API can be region-pinned (US) for the POC and what logs are retained where.
- Schedule: technical deep dive on VPC/private requirements + timeline (if POC succeeds).

Internal notes
- This account will likely require tighter language in docs and potentially a Console/org-level toggle to reduce/disable certain analytics during POC.
- Recommend aligning responses with the internal onboarding telemetry privacy review doc; avoid ad-hoc promises outside stated retention/access controls.
